subject: GCP Marketplace: SKU reshuffle + co-sell playbook (Skasphere private offer)
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya@redwood.ai>
To: Ekaterina Volkov <ekaterina@skasphere.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: GCP Marketplace: SKU reshuffle + co-sell playbook (Skasphere private offer)

Hi Ekaterina,

Thanks again for the time yesterday. Following up with a concrete kickoff for the private offer burn/run-rate alignment and the co-sell handoff. We heard your ask to reassign a small subset of SKUs (compute-heavy SKUs) to the new usage bucket so you can prioritize AI inference workloads for the Q3 pilots.

Attached: a proposed mutual action plan (MAP_Skasphere_v1.xlsx) and a draft SKU mapping (SKU_Mapping_v2.pdf). High-level asks from our side:
- Confirm target monthly burn profile for July–Sep (so we can set drawdown triggers).
- Finalize the SKU list to move (we highlighted 6 SKUs in the PDF).
- Align on co-sell ownership for enterprise opportunities (we recommend GCP reps own pursuit, Redwood handles technical deck + PoC).

Proposed next steps:
1) You confirm the SKU subset by Friday 7/2.
2) We update the PO/docusign and circulate for signatures (we can accelerate if procurement shares preferred billing contact).
3) Karthik and Marissa will run a 30-min ops sync with your GCP partner to lock the co-sell motions.

If that sequencing works, I’ll schedule the ops call and push the DocuSign template.

Thanks,

--
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
aditya@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0198

From: Ekaterina Volkov <ekaterina@skasphere.io>

Cc: procurements@skasphere.io
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:03:00 +0300
Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: SKU reshuffle + co-sell playbook (Skasphere private offer)

Aditya,

Appreciate the clear plan and the attachments. Quick notes from procurement: we can sign off on the SKU subset but need two clarifications before we update internal PO timing:
1) Can you confirm whether the reshuffled SKUs will change unit pricing or just the billing bucket (we prefer no unit price changes mid-contract).
2) We need a one-page summary for our legal team that explains how drawdown triggers map to invoice timing.

We expect to confirm SKU list by EOD Friday 7/2. Once we do, please send the DocuSign and the one-pager for legal.

Regards,

Ekaterina Volkov
Head of Procurement, Skasphere
ekaterina@skasphere.io
procurements@skasphere.io

Thanks — flagged a couple of operational items after reviewing the SKU PDF:
- For the 6 compute SKUs listed, we should map two of them to the existing committed bucket and four into the accelerated/burst bucket. That preserves committed economics while giving them runway for spikes.
- I’ll loop in the GCP Partner Manager and request a brief co-sell alignment call. Please confirm if Skasphere wants the GCP rep on the call or prefers a separate handoff.
- I’ve drafted the one-page drawdown->invoice mapping for legal; will attach the doc to the DocuSign envelope.

Marissa — can you confirm the suggested attendee list for the ops sync and own the GCP partner outreach? I’ll leave time slots open Friday afternoon PT.

-Karthik

Subject: Re: GCP Marketplace: SKU reshuffle + co-sell playbook (Skasphere private offer)

Perfect — I’ll coordinate with our GCP partner contact and propose two time slots (Fri 2pm PT / Mon 9am PT). Attendee list from our side: Aditya (AM), Karthik (partner lead), Marissa (marketplaces ops), plus GCP Partner Manager. Please add Skasphere engineering lead if you want the SKU technical mapping reviewed live.

Ekaterina — we will not change unit prices as part of the SKU reassignment; the mapping is purely billing-bucket reclassification. I’ve attached a short summary to the shared Drive link and will add the one-pager to the DocuSign envelope.

Also attaching a quick ops checklist in the Drive (GCP_Private_Offer_Summary.docx) so procurement/legal can pick it up.
